subject: english
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Phase** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • A **phase **refers to a distinct period or stage in a process or development. (किसी प्रक्रिया या विकास में एक विशिष्ट अवधि या चरण) • **Example**: *In the first phase of the project, we conducted extensive research to gather data and define key objectives.* • It is often used to describe a specific time frame or a step in a sequence. • In this context, the blank is asking for a word that fits the idea of progress or change. Thus, **option 2 **is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Transition **refers to a change from one state or condition to another. (एक अवस्था या स्थिति से दूसरी अवस्था में परिवर्तन) • **Feeling **refers to an emotional state or sensation. (एक भावनात्मक स्थिति या अनुभूति) • **Milestone **refers to a significant event or achievement. (कोई महत्वपूर्ण घटना या उपलब्धि) 48:Tc23, The correct answer is: "**act**".
